layers.question: Did this observable file state probably change?
layers.authority_posture: Fast change detection only; not proof of content sameness.

layers.question: Is this exact file content already known?
layers.authority_posture: Exact byte-stream identity only; not canonical preference.

layers.question: Which parts changed or overlap?
layers.authority_posture: Fine-grained comparison evidence; shared chunks are candidates for review.

layers.question: What text can deterministic tools compare, tag, or index?
layers.authority_posture: Generated evidence surface; source files remain authoritative.

layers.question: What assets are semantically similar?
layers.authority_posture: Semantic discovery only after privacy, license, provider, retention, and eval gates.

layers.question: How does this asset relate to systems, workflows, schemas, tests, people, risks, and future uses?
layers.authority_posture: Reviewable relationship evidence; candidate edges do not prove truth.

layers.question: Who/what observed, generated, changed, or approved this asset record?
Is this probably a modified version of a binary/export asset?
layers.authority_posture: Optional near-duplicate signal; requires an evaluation set before promotion.
